dashboard.note: Recorded nights are SYNTHETIC (generated by the engine) until UMass Dining shares real exports.

bench.title: Portions eaten and average portions on hand by hour, every night and scenario
bench.why: The raw query works out a local-time hour for every row; the aggregate keeps one row per dish and hour, about nine times fewer to read.
bench.raw_sql:
SELECT extract(hour FROM ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::int AS hour, scenario,
       sum(portions_eaten)::int AS eaten, round(avg(portions_left), 1) AS avg_on_hand
FROM dcsim.pan_windows GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
bench.agg_sql:
SELECT extract(hour FROM bucket AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::int AS hour, scenario,
       sum(portions_eaten)::int AS eaten, round(sum(sum_left) / sum(windows), 1) AS avg_on_hand
FROM dcsim.pan_hourly GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

bench.title: One night's pans by dish and hour (the dashboard's pan chart)
bench.why: The dashboard's own read: one night out of the whole table.
bench.raw_sql:
SELECT dish_id, extract(hour FROM ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::int AS hour,
       sum(portions_out)::int AS put_out, sum(portions_eaten)::int AS eaten, min(portions_left) AS lowest
FROM dcsim.pan_windows WHERE scenario = 'observed' AND night = '2026-11-07' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
bench.agg_sql:
SELECT dish_id, extract(hour FROM bucket AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::int AS hour,
       sum(portions_out)::int AS put_out, sum(portions_eaten)::int AS eaten, min(min_left) AS lowest
FROM dcsim.pan_hourly WHERE scenario = 'observed' AND night = '2026-11-07' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

bench.title: Portions put out and eaten per dish, replays of every night
bench.why: Grouped by the columns the columnstore is segmented by (scenario, dish): fully converted chunks are summed batch by batch, so the raw table needs no aggregate here. After a reload leaves chunks in the row store, the aggregate is the faster one until they are converted again (dcsim tsdb compress).
bench.raw_sql:
SELECT dish_id, sum(portions_out)::bigint AS put_out, sum(portions_eaten)::bigint AS eaten,
       min(portions_left) AS lowest
FROM dcsim.pan_windows WHERE scenario = 'replay' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
bench.agg_sql:
SELECT dish_id, sum(portions_out)::bigint AS put_out, sum(portions_eaten)::bigint AS eaten,
       min(min_left) AS lowest
FROM dcsim.pan_hourly WHERE scenario = 'replay' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

bench.title: Waste by night and reason (the dashboard's bars)
bench.why: A small table: about 250 weigh-ins a night, and the aggregate keeps one row per dish, night and reason, so it only halves the rows.
bench.raw_sql:
SELECT night, reason, round(sum(weight_lb)::numeric, 1) AS lb, count(*) AS weigh_ins
FROM dcsim.waste_log GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
bench.agg_sql:
SELECT night, reason, round(sum(weight_lb)::numeric, 1) AS lb, sum(events)::bigint AS weigh_ins
FROM dcsim.waste_daily_by_dish GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
